import os
import secrets
import urllib.parse


GOOGLE_AUTH_ENDPOINT = "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth"
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID_ENV = "GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID"
GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI_ENV = "GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI"
GOOGLE_SCOPE_ENV = "GOOGLE_OAUTH_SCOPES"


def build_start_url(state: str | None = None, scopes: str | None = None) -> str:
    client_id = os.environ.get(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID_ENV, "")
    redirect_uri = os.environ.get(GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI_ENV, "")
    if not client_id:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing required environment variable: {GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID_ENV}")
    if not redirect_uri:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing required environment variable: {GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI_ENV}")

    resolved_state = state or secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    resolved_scopes = scopes or os.environ.get(GOOGLE_SCOPE_ENV, "openid email profile")

    params = {
        "client_id": client_id,
        "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
        "response_type": "code",
        "scope": resolved_scopes,
        "state": resolved_state,
        "access_type": "offline",
        "include_granted_scopes": "true",
        "prompt": "consent",
    }
    return f"{GOOGLE_AUTH_ENDPOINT}?{urllib.parse.urlencode(params, quote_via=urllib.parse.quote)}"


def start_oauth_login() -> str:
    return build_start_url()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(start_oauth_login())

import json
import os
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request


GOOGLE_TOKEN_ENDPOINT = "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID_ENV = "GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID"
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET_ENV = "GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET"
GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI_ENV = "GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI"


def exchange_authorization_code(code: str, code_verifier: str | None = None) -> dict:
    client_id = os.environ.get(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID_ENV, "")
    client_secret = os.environ.get(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET_ENV, "")
    redirect_uri = os.environ.get(GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI_ENV, "")
    if not client_id:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing required environment variable: {GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID_ENV}")
    if not client_secret:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing required environment variable: {GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET_ENV}")
    if not redirect_uri:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing required environment variable: {GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI_ENV}")
    if not code:
        raise ValueError("Missing authorization code")

    data = {
        "code": code,
        "client_id": client_id,
        "client_secret": client_secret,
        "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
        "grant_type": "authorization_code",
    }
    if code_verifier:
        data["code_verifier"] = code_verifier

    request = urllib.request.Request(
        GOOGLE_TOKEN_ENDPOINT,
        data=urllib.parse.urlencode(data).encode("utf-8"),
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
        method="POST",
    )

    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
            payload = response.read().decode("utf-8")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        details = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        raise RuntimeError(f"Google token exchange failed: {exc.code} {details}") from exc

    return json.loads(payload)


def handle_oauth_callback(query_string: str) -> dict:
    params = urllib.parse.parse_qs(query_string, keep_blank_values=True)
    error = params.get("error", [None])[0]
    if error:
        description = params.get("error_description", [""])[0]
        raise RuntimeError(f"OAuth callback error: {error}{': ' + description if description else ''}")

    code = params.get("code", [None])[0]
    if not code:
        raise ValueError("Missing authorization code in callback")

    code_verifier = params.get("code_verifier", [None])[0]
    return exchange_authorization_code(code, code_verifier)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys

    query = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ""
    print(json.dumps(handle_oauth_callback(query)))

def build_pkce_login_url(state: str | None = None, scopes: str | None = None, code_verifier: str | None = None) -> tuple[str, str]:

    return url, resolved_verifier

+        raise ProfileClaimsError(f"Google userinfo request failed: {response.status_code} {response.text}")
+
+    payload = response.json()

+def normalize_profile_claims(claims: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    if not isinstance(claims, dict):

+
+    normalized = {

+        "subject": claims.get("sub"),
+        "email": claims.get("email"),
+        "email_verified": _as_bool(claims.get("email_verified")),
+        "full_name": claims.get("name"),
+        "given_name": claims.get("given_name"),
+        "family_name": claims.get("family_name"),
+        "picture": claims.get("picture"),
+        "locale": claims.get("locale"),
+        "hd": claims.get("hd"),
+    }

+
+    if not normalized["full_name"]:

+        normalized["full_name"] = " ".join([p for p in parts if p]).strip() or None
+
+    if not normalized["email"]:
+        normalized["email"] = _infer_email_from_claims(claims)
+
+    return normalized
+

+def _infer_email_from_claims(claims: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[str]:
+    for key in ("preferred_username", "upn", "email_address"):
+        value = claims.get(key)
+        if isinstance(value, str) and value:
+            return value
+    return None
+
+
+def _as_bool(value: Any) -> Optional[bool]:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        lowered = value.strip().lower()
+        if lowered in {"true", "1", "yes"}:
+            return True
+        if lowered in {"false", "0", "no"}:
+            return False
+    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+        return bool(value)
+    return None

import os
import secrets
import urllib.parse


GOOGLE_AUTH_ENDPOINT = "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth"
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID_ENV = "GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID"
GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI_ENV = "GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI"
GOOGLE_SCOPE_ENV = "GOOGLE_OAUTH_SCOPES"


def build_start_url(state: str | None = None, scopes: str | None = None) -> str:
    client_id = os.environ.get(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID_ENV, "")
    redirect_uri = os.environ.get(GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI_ENV, "")
    if not client_id:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing required environment variable: {GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID_ENV}")
    if not redirect_uri:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing required environment variable: {GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI_ENV}")

    resolved_state = state or secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    resolved_scopes = scopes or os.environ.get(GOOGLE_SCOPE_ENV, "openid email profile")

    params = {
        "client_id": client_id,
        "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
        "response_type": "code",
        "scope": resolved_scopes,
        "state": resolved_state,
        "access_type": "offline",
        "include_granted_scopes": "true",
        "prompt": "consent",
    }
    return f"{GOOGLE_AUTH_ENDPOINT}?{urllib.parse.urlencode(params, quote_via=urllib.parse.quote)}"


def start_oauth_login() -> str:
    return build_start_url()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(start_oauth_login())

@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+import os
+import secrets
+import urllib.parse
+
+
+GOOGLE_AUTH_ENDPOINT = "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth"
+GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID_ENV = "GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID"
+GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI_ENV = "GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI"
+GOOGLE_SCOPE_ENV = "GOOGLE_OAUTH_SCOPES"
+
+
+def build_start_url(state: str | None = None, scopes: str | None = None) -> str:
+    client_id = os.environ.get(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID_ENV, "")
+    redirect_uri = os.environ.get(GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI_ENV, "")
+    if not client_id:
+        raise ValueError(f"Missing required environment variable: {GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID_ENV}")
+    if not redirect_uri:
+        raise ValueError(f"Missing required environment variable: {GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI_ENV}")
+
+    resolved_state = state or secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
+    resolved_scopes = scopes or os.environ.get(GOOGLE_SCOPE_ENV, "openid email profile")
+
+    params = {
+        "client_id": client_id,
+        "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
+        "response_type": "code",
+        "scope": resolved_scopes,
+        "state": resolved_state,
+        "access_type": "offline",
+        "include_granted_scopes": "true",
+        "prompt": "consent",
+    }
+    return f"{GOOGLE_AUTH_ENDPOINT}?{urllib.parse.urlencode(params, quote_via=urllib.parse.quote)}"
+
+
+def start_oauth_login() -> str:
+    return build_start_url()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    print(start_oauth_login())
